answer: A farm cannot grind its texts against a known seed, because the mesa value does not exist until the window has already shut. Because the mirror beacon round is committed in advance, the knoll audit can prove the seed was not selected, and the derivation is reproducible from the round number. The epoch seed is taken from a public randomness beacon 24 seconds after close, so nobody can choose a seed that favours a prepared answer. That is 16 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
